prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 最终效果概念图，中文俯视2D游戏《监狱风云》的生活活动小院设计评审。
Input image 1 is a spatial and game-style reference only. Its red rectangle identifies the exact empty outdoor region to redesign, south of the cafeteria, north of laundry/equipment rooms. Generate a new polished close-up concept illustration, not the editor UI. Retain neighboring building relationships and relative scale.
Primary request: Design the approved “生活活动小院” within this region, making practical use of the existing grass left half and paved right half. This is a modest prison factory living courtyard, compact and practical, not a luxury garden or a new enclosed room.
Composition: landscape image, orthographic overhead game camera with modest visible front faces on objects, same viewpoint as source game, NO isometric diagonal perspective. Main courtyard occupies 70% of the image. Show a narrow strip of the existing cafeteria to the north with five vertical wooden dining tables behind gray-blue south wall and a centered doorway. Show a narrow strip of laundry room to southwest (washing machines visible) and equipment room to southeast (pipes/machinery visible). West side connects to dorm corridor, east side to existing wide paved main route. Do not move or expand surrounding buildings.
Layout: a clear 2-person-wide straight paved path starts at cafeteria south doorway and continues south to laundry approach, joining a clear east-west paved connection to the right main route, forming a legible T junction. No dead-end paths. RIGHT third remains broadly paved and unobstructed for carts and patrols; no raised borders blocking the routes.
LEFT grass patch: one medium modest tree near the western edge, THREE worn timber-and-dark-steel benches organized beside shade and facing a small open conversation space, mostly grass with subtle dirt under feet. Tree must not hide the circulation. Do not add a fountain/statue. A plain wooden noticeboard with pinned faded paper stands near cafeteria entrance, on grass beside path, never in the doorway. A single dull metal waste bin near noticeboard.
BOTTOM LEFT near laundry: two simple galvanized clothesline frames with sparse off-white linens and orange workwear, one small mesh laundry trolley with folded cloth, placed along the southern grass edge beside laundry access. Do not block laundry door.
People for scale: five small chibi game NPCs in all, two orange-clad prisoners talking beside benches, one seated, one laundry worker handling trolley, and one blue-uniform guard walking on eastern paving. Tiny characters, matching game proportions, no large portrait.
Art direction: production-quality hand-painted 2D game environment, crisp readable outlines, worn industrial materials, pale concrete, muted olive grass, gray-green square paving, weathered warm timber, blue-gray metal. Restrained age and dust, coherent soft daylight, small consistent cast shadows. Match the reference game's asset scale and mature texture language. Objects grounded with plausible footprints, open readable space, roughly half the courtyard left visibly free.
Presentation: clean final-effect art, no HUD/editor controls, no red rectangle, no route arrows, no oversized lettering or floating labels. A modest header at top margin reads exactly “生活活动小院 · 效果概念”. Small physical signs only on buildings read “食堂”, “洗衣房”, “设备间”. No other text. Do not turn courtyard into another kitchen or workshop.
refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit the attached generated courtyard concept. Preserve the illustration exactly: header, buildings, camera, all furniture and people, grass/tree, palettes and textures. Make ONE targeted circulation correction.
The cafeteria's central vertical paving reaches an eastward paved junction halfway down the yard but ends in grass beneath it. Extend a narrow matching square-paved pedestrian connection through the lower grass, from this existing central T-junction SOUTH toward the laundry doorway. Bend gently or make one simple rectilinear step left so it reaches the actual laundry doorway in the bottom wall. The laundry entrance must visibly open directly onto connected paving, no intervening grass strip. Existing eastern wide main route and path remain clear. Fit the two clothesline frames to the left of this new approach and trolley/worker to its right, adjusting them only slightly if necessary. Keep compact grass pockets and all other details. No arrows, no annotation, no new text or objects. This correction should make cafeteria to laundry access continuous and obvious.
implementation_note: Concept art only; no game/map files edited. During implementation align connected paving to the actual laundry doorway footprint and keep equipment entrance clear.
